profile: An engineer who learned to love the funnel. Product manager and hands-on AI builder with experience across consumer subscriptions, international D2C and backend engineering. Combines discovery, experimentation and commercial judgement with the ability to design and ship working products, from assisted-sales journeys at Times Internet to independent AI and consumer tools.

roles.title: Independent Product Builder | AI & Consumer Products
roles.sub: Built AI agents, marketing platforms and family-care products from concept to working software.
bullets: Parwah: Led product discovery, UX and engineering for a live family-care platform, enabling relatives in different cities to coordinate care through shared tasks, documents and parent-controlled permissions.
Lifecycle OS: Designed and built a 16-module D2C marketing platform with a 90-day campaign-planning workflow, connecting audience analysis, campaign briefs and creative production in one workspace.
The Third Eye: Built a personal AI assistant combining retrieval-based memory, tool calling and voice-driven workflows to connect conversational context with task execution.
Mailer Architect: Built a multi-model email-generation workflow with catalogue-aware product selection and provider fallbacks, turning campaign briefs into brand-aligned HTML emails.

roles.title: VAHDAM India | AGM, Product Management & D2C Growth
roles.sub: D2C product strategy, conversion optimisation and lifecycle growth across US, UK and global markets.
bullets: Led D2C product and growth initiatives across US, UK and global markets, using funnel analysis to prioritise improvements to purchase journeys, conversion and lifecycle CRM.

Connected customer analytics, segmentation, campaign planning and email production into a retention workflow; ran Klaviyo and WebEngage experiments that contributed to UK marketing revenue growth within two months.

roles.title: Times Internet | Senior Product Manager
roles.sub: Consumer subscriptions, product growth and new revenue initiatives.
bullets: Scaled ET Prime assisted-sales revenue from ₹15 lakh to ₹80 lakh per month in four months through funnel redesign and A/B experimentation; delivered 400%+ ROI within six months. Received the ET Prime Team Award (2025) as part of the team.
Led the ET Markets web and mobile-web redesign: +27% engagement and ₹3 crore+ incremental annual revenue. App improvements contributed to +25% DAU, +15% session duration and +19% screen views.
Built assisted-buying journeys that increased qualified leads from approximately 30 to 150+ per day; onboarding and engagement experiments improved subscriber retention by 10%.
Built AI TeleSuite for call transcription, quality scoring and pitch guidance to standardise sales coaching.
Launched the inaugural Times Internet Delhi Half Marathon, establishing a new revenue channel and attracting 15,000+ participants.
roles.previous_roles: Earlier roles: Product Manager (Oct 2023 - Mar 2025) · Associate Product Manager (Jun 2022 - Oct 2023)
